environment.description: Laravel 10.x application running on PHP-FPM 8.2 with pcntl extension enabled, deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No CSP headers configured. The application error handler (App\Exceptions\Handler) renders debug views in production due to APP_DEBUG=true misconfiguration. The Blade template uses {!! !!} unescaped output for the inline analytics script containing the raw search query.
